# Ankhorage Hetzner Infrastructure

![license: MIT](././paradox/badges/license.svg) ![npm: v0.3.4](././paradox/badges/npm.svg) ![runtime: bun](././paradox/badges/runtime.svg) ![typescript: strict](././paradox/badges/typescript.svg) ![eslint: checked](././paradox/badges/eslint.svg) ![prettier: checked](././paradox/badges/prettier.svg) ![build: checked](././paradox/badges/build.svg) ![tests: configured](././paradox/badges/tests.svg) ![paradox: warnings](././paradox/badges/docs.svg)

Provides a Hetzner Cloud compute adapter with REST-backed lifecycle operations and shell-free SSH host verification.

Translate provider-neutral compute intent into Hetzner Cloud server lifecycle behavior without leaking provider credentials into portable state.

<summary>createInfraAdapter</summary>

```ts
createInfraAdapter(options?: HetznerAdapterOptions) => InfraComputeAdapter<"hetzner">
```

Create the canonical Hetzner Cloud compute adapter.

The default composition uses the authenticated Cloud REST API and a shell-free SSH host-key
probe. Provider API and SSH credentials remain transient execution inputs.
